description: This Zenodo deposit maps local climate zones and urban morphology at about 100-metre resolution for Athens, Thessaloniki, Larissa, Patras and Heraklion. Researchers combined Greek elevation and built-environment sources with Copernicus multispectral and radar observations to derive classes and parameters such as building height and street height-to-width ratio. The named public archive is available under CC BY 4.0 without registration. Coverage is five populous Greek cities, not a national street-level building inventory or in-situ heat observation series. Remote-sensing classification, building-height inputs and spatial averaging are limitations for individual blocks. A reviewer-assessed use is supplying urban-form parameters to heat, ventilation or mesoscale climate simulations. model-palm-4u-urban-climate is a related urban-climate model, but the article does not establish a direct format conversion into it. The article cites GIS4WRF as a separate software dependency; this record identifies the published Greek data release. Archive contents and map accuracy were not independently inspected.
